items.text:
Updated Review: Just played the latest version of this title & my second play through. Runs at 144hz & over 30 fps. Makes a massive difference to the minecraft like graphics. 

I decided to start my adventure as a character called Dave. It all started fairly early in the day & he prepped the veg, awaiting his date to arrive. By 5PM Dave had already sunk 3 glasses of wine & his attitude towards the date begun to sound more like he was just after a quickie. It probably was for the best that his date never arrived because as the night continued the attitude towards life begun to take a downward spiral and he picked up his cigarettes. After just one cigarette he started to hallucinate and for a moment thought he date had arrived. He ran to the door to find out his neighbours were yet again playing "Knock a door run". Dave took this opportunity to grab his coat and go for a long walk. This is the last interaction I had with Dave but I wish him all the best.

Ultimately, I know I got the best end of the bargain as the game has gone up by almost £1 since I purchased this. I guess Brexit is the real loser here.

R.I.P Dave

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
items.text_zh:
更新评论：刚玩了这款游戏的最新版本，也是我的第二周目。以144Hz和超过30帧运行。对类似《我的世界》的画面带来了巨大的差别。

我决定以一个叫Dave的角色开始我的冒险。这一切在当天相当早的时候就开始了，他准备好了蔬菜，等待他的约会对象到来。到下午5点，Dave已经灌下了3杯葡萄酒，他对约会的态度开始听起来更像是他只想快速来一发。他的约会对象始终没有出现，这大概是最好的结果，因为随着夜晚继续，对生活的态度开始向下螺旋，他拿起了他的香烟。仅仅抽了一根烟后，他就开始产生幻觉，有一瞬间以为他的约会对象已经到了。他跑到门口，却发现他的邻居们又在玩“按门铃就跑”。Dave借此机会抓起他的外套，出去长时间散步。这是我和Dave的最后一次互动，但我祝他一切顺利。

最终，我知道我占了最大的便宜，因为自从我购买这款游戏以来，它已经涨了将近1英镑。我猜英国脱欧才是这里真正的输家。

安息吧，Dave

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
